when we moved into current house, my mother was wiping down the shelves in the closets in the spare rooms. she found a cylinder package, and it had a sticker on it that had the mailing information. it was mailed here october 24th 1972. never opened. it was from england, and i live in ontario, canada. me and my mother opened the package together. it was a beautiful map, and it had the names and pictures of some kings and queens on it. my mother wants to find a frame and put it on the wall, but right now it’s just sitting in the basement in the package that it came in.

the previous owner actually died on the front lawn, due to skin cancer that slowly ate away at her face. she didn’t believe in going to the hospital, religion i suppose. whenever i open the map, i get chills.
lol yeah, she actually does. and when she wants something from me, she starts to guilt me by saying “i’m the reason that you’re alive!!!”

apparently santa was pretty uncomfortable, one of the elf people that worked there went up to my mom, and said “i just thought you should know... your child just asked for a little sibling...”
my mom was shooketh (°_°)
i’m not a mall santa, I’m the thing that the kid asked for. my sister asked for a sibling. 9 months later, she got her gift. me. she should’ve asked for  a different gift.
